summary.result: As the results, three different levels of riparian widths were proposed depending on the major riparian functions and applied to the Jinwee stream section as the case study.
summary.background: Riparian management has become important as stream water quality as well as riparian ecosystem gain more public attentions.
summary.method: The proposed method can be used to determine riparian width in other stream areas based on different functional focus, ie, water quality or riparian conservation purposes.
